# pbs_smtp_notification (Resource)

Manages an SMTP notification target.

Configure an SMTP server to receive notifications from PBS about backup jobs, 
verification tasks, and system events.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `from_address` (String) Sender email address. This will appear as the 'From' address in notification emails.
- `name` (String) The unique name identifier for the SMTP notification target.
- `server` (String) SMTP server hostname or IP address.

### Optional

- `author` (String) Author name that will appear in the email headers.
- `comment` (String) A comment describing this notification target.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable this notification target. Defaults to `false`.
- `mailto` (List of String) Recipient email address(es). Specify as a list of email strings.
- `mailto_user` (List of String) User(s) from PBS user database to receive notifications. Specify as PBS user IDs.
- `mode` (String) Connection mode for SMTP. Valid values: `insecure` (no encryption), `starttls` (upgrade to TLS), `tls` (direct TLS). Defaults to `insecure`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) SMTP authentication password. Required if the SMTP server requires authentication.
- `port` (Number) SMTP server port. Common values: `25` (unencrypted), `465` (TLS), `587` (STARTTLS). Defaults to `25`.
- `username` (String) SMTP authentication username. Required if the SMTP server requires authentication.

### Read-Only

- `origin` (String) Origin of this configuration as reported by PBS (e.g., `user`, `builtin`).
